name: Defensive Stance
description: A defensive combat stance.  Decreases damage taken by 10% and damage caused by 10%.  Increases all threat generated by 80%.

name: Shield Bash
description: Bashes the target with your shield for 6 damage.  It also interrupts spellcasting and prevents any spell in that school from being cast for 6 sec.

name: Dodge
description: Gives a chance to dodge enemy melee attacks.

name: Charge
description: Charge an enemy, generate 9 Rage, and Stun it for 1 sec.  Cannot be used in combat.

name: Block
description: Gives a chance to block enemy melee and ranged attacks.

name: Taunt
description: Taunts the target to attack you, but has no effect if the target is already attacking you.

name: Dual Wield
description: Allows one-hand and off-hand weapons to be equipped in the off-hand.

name: Disarm
description: Disarm the enemy's weapon for 10 sec.

name: Mocking Blow
description: A mocking attack that causes 22 damage, a moderate amount of threat and forces the target to focus attacks on you for 6 sec.

name: Cleave
description: A sweeping attack that does your weapon damage plus 5 to the target and a second nearby enemy.

name: Heroic Strike
description: A strong attack that increases melee damage by 44 and causes a high amount of threat.

name: Hamstring
description: Maims the enemy, causing 5 damage and slowing the enemy's movement by 40% for 15 sec.

name: Battle Stance
description: A balanced combat stance.

name: Cooking
description: Allows a cook to make basic recipes up to a maximum potential skill of 75.  Requires meat from beasts and fire to make food.

name: Shield Block
description: Increases chance to block by 75% for 7 sec, but will only block 2 attacks.

name: Find Minerals
description: Nearby mineral veins appear on the minimap.   Only one type of thing can be tracked at a time.

name: Smelting
description: Allows the miner to turn ore into metal bars.  This skill requires a forge.

name: Bloodrage
description: Generates 10 rage at the cost of health, and then generates an additional 10 rage over 10 sec.

name: Throw
description: Hurl a thrown weapon at the target.

name: Blacksmithing
description: Allows a Blacksmith to make well-crafted weapons and armor up to a maximum potential skill of 150.

name: Parry
description: Gives a chance to parry enemy melee attacks.

name: First Aid
description: Allows the creation and use of bandages up to a potential skill of 150.   The cloth used to make those bandages are found on humanoids in the world.

name: Intimidating Shout
description: The warrior shouts, causing the targeted enemy to cower in fear.  Up to 5 enemies within 8 yds will flee in fear.  Lasts 8 sec.

name: Execute
description: Attempt to finish off a wounded foe, causing 125 damage and converting each extra point of rage into 3 additional damage.  Only usable on enemies that have 20% or less health.

name: Demoralizing Shout
description: Reduces the melee attack power of all enemies within 10 yards by 78 for 45 sec.

name: Battle Shout
description: The warrior shouts, increasing the melee attack power of all party or raid members within 20 yards by 33.  Lasts 3 min.

name: Rend
description: Wounds the target causing them to bleed for 45 damage over 15 sec.

name: Revenge
description: Instantly counterattack an enemy for 99 to 105 damage and a high amount of threat.  Revenge must follow a block, dodge or parry.

name: Overpower
description: Instantly overpower the enemy, causing weapon damage plus 5.  Only useable after the target dodges.  The Overpower cannot be blocked, dodged or parried.

name: Sunder Armor
description: Sunders the target's armor, reducing it by 180 per Sunder Armor and causes a high amount of threat.  Can be applied up to 5 times.  Lasts 30 sec.

name: Thunder Clap
description: Blasts nearby enemies with thunder increasing, the time between their attacks by 20% for 14 sec and doing 23 damage to them. Will affect up to 4 targets.

name: Retaliation
description: Instantly counterattack any enemy that strikes you in melee for 15 sec.  Melee attacks made from behind cannot be counterattacked.  A maximum of 30 attacks will cause retaliation.

name: Shadowmeld
description: Activate to slip into the shadows, reducing the chance for enemies to detect your presence. Lasts until cancelled or upon moving. Using this ability in combat discourages enemies from attacking you, but increases the cooldown to 2 min.

name: Quickness
description: Dodge chance increased by 1% and movement speed increased by 2%. Night Elf Rogues and Druids are harder to detect in Stealth as if they were 1 level higher.

name: Wisp Spirit
description: Transform into a wisp upon death, increasing movement speed by 75%.

name: Victory Rush
description: Instantly attack the target causing 42 damage and healing you for 10% of your maximum health.  Only useable within 20 sec after you kill a non-trivial enemy.

name: Slam
description: Slams the opponent, causing weapon damage plus 16.

name: Elune's Light
description: Increases your critical strike chance with all spells and attacks by 10% for 15 sec.

name: Languages
description: You are fluent in the following languages:  Common  Darnassian

name: Armor Proficiency
description: You are proficient in the use of the following armor types:  Cloth  Leather  Mail

name: Tactical Mastery
description: You retain up to 10 Rage when you change Stances.

name: Firebolt
description: Blasts a target for 42 Fire damage.
